fields.name: Nityānanda dāsa «Sādhu» (Navadvīpa)
fields.disappearance: 1913, at Navadvīpa, in the cholera epidemic (the record's text)
fields.place: Born at Kaluṭolā (Calcutta); Navadvīpa (Śrī Rādhāramaṇa Sevāśrama and Mātṛ-mandira, 1911)
fields.notes: Born Puliśabihārī Mallika at Kaluṭolā; won over with his family by Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa Deva's saṅkīrtana in 1896; by his order founded the Rādhāramaṇa Sevāśrama and Mātṛ-mandira at Navadvīpa (1911); called «Sādhu» for his service; died in 1913 chanting Harināma after nursing the cholera victims.

fields.name: Jiyaḍa Nṛsiṁha Barāṭ
fields.disciples: Siddha Caitanya dāsa Bābājī of Navadvīpa (dīkṣā in the Gaura-mantra)
fields.notes: Of a vaidya family of Burdwan, with a high post in the Judges' Court; practised Gaura-bhajana in kānta-bhāva. Rāmatanu Bhāgavata-bhūṣaṇa (#1231) came to him and they did bhajana together, until a difference of opinion parted them; he gave Siddha Caitanya dāsa Bābājī of Navadvīpa dīkṣā in the Gaura-mantra.
